_comment: Coordinator's tool scope. Enforces 'never composes PR text', 'never writes program.md', 'one writer per file' guarantees. Read this together with coordinator/program.md.

_notes.intent_summary: Coordinator reads state, mutates only its own state files (queue shards, sessions.json, prs.json, portfolio-events.jsonl), executes ssh/tmux/gh to interact with executors and GitHub. Does NOT write program.md, pr_body.md, retrospective.md, portfolio.md, or experiment outputs. Does NOT make local git commits or push. Brain or experiment agents own those.
_notes.why_no_git_writes: Coordinator detecting that a branch is in a bad state means: escalate to brain. Coordinator pushing a fix would be acting outside its scope and harder to audit.
_notes.tmux_scope: Coordinator uses tmux to control executor sessions, capture panes, send keys. tmux send-keys to executors is allowed because that's the dispatch mechanism. tmux on coordinator's own session is implicit (it's running in tmux).
_notes.ssh_scope: Scoped to ssh:* because coordinator must reach all executor hosts. SSH key already configured per setup scripts.
